address: 13 Chelsea Road, Bath, BA1 3DU, United Kingdom
bio: Fitting in nicely among a parade of independent shops in the west of the city, this intimate operation holds just three tables. The set menu features plenty of prime seafood like hand-dived Orkney scallops and succulent wild turbot, alongside meats such as best end of lamb. This seasonal produce is often accompanied by subtle international flavours and an edge of modernity, but a classical French base is never far away. France dominates the wine list too, with small-scale producers pushed to the fore, many of which are organic and biodynamic....
